title: Retail spell effects: 161 models with translated particles, ribbons and HD textures
description: Exports the 161 spell effect models the game uses (every player ability and common enemy cast) and their 258 textures from your own Retail client, converts the models to the game's MD20 v256 including the particle and ribbon emitters (modern to native emitter translation), and publishes the textures under a private path (Spells\AzerothSurvivorsHD\R\) so the official patch files never have to be overridden. Replaces the native model for every ability that uses it. Cosmetic only.
provenance: Retail 12.1.5.70448 FileDataIDs listed below; converter spells_step.py (pins fx_convert.py, fx_particles.py, fx_models.json, m2ir.py, skinned_convert.py). Output: 161 models, 499 particle emitters, 91 ribbons, 258 textures (8226568 bytes, Retail BLP2 DXT with mips, shipped unchanged).
limits: Emitters use the first texture only (multi-texture particles), no scale/lifespan/rate variance, no geometry or recursion particles; colour, alpha and scale over life are resampled to 3 keys.
Mesh effect shaders are dropped (the skinned converter flattens them to the native blend modes).
Several Retail effects use fewer emitters than the classic ones (modern re-design); see conversion-report.json.
Replaces the model for every ability that shares it; no per-ability opt-out.
